headline: ITI Ltd clarifies CFO and CEO portal filing error
summary: The Investment Trust of India Limited has issued a clarification to the stock exchanges regarding an inadvertent error on the BSE listing portal. The company mistakenly referred to a Chief Financial Officer instead of a Chief Executive Officer in a previous submission. This is a routine administrative correction with no financial or operational impact on the company. Retail investors can disregard this procedural filing as it does not affect business fundamentals.
why_it_matters: Zero financial impact on your investments
